name: Emoji Sentences
desc: Decode the saying from the emojis. Higher values include Egyptian proverbs.
arabic_answers: El erd fi 'ein ommo ghazal: the monkey is a gazelle in its mother's eyes
El 'ersh el abyad yenfa' fel yom el eswed: the white piastre helps on the black day
Ekfi el 'edra 'ala bo'aha, tetla' el bent le ommaha: flip the pot on its mouth, the daughter turns out like her mother
Elli ekhtasho mato: the shy ones have died
Elli ma ye'rafsh ye'ool 'ads: he who doesn't know says it's lentils
Ya wakhed el 'erd 'ala malo, yerooh el mal wel 'erd yefdal 'ala halo: marry the monkey for its money, the money goes and the monkey stays
El 'ein ma tetla'sh 'an el hageb: the eye doesn't rise above the eyebrow
Ba'd ma shab waddoh el kottab: after he grew old they sent him to school
Zay el atrash fel zaffa: like the deaf man at the wedding
El bab elli yegilak meno el reeh, seddo w estereeh: the door that brings in wind, shut it and rest
Ibn el wezz 'awwam: the duckling is a swimmer
Elli fat mat: what's past is dead
'Ala 'ad lehafak med reglak: stretch your legs only as far as your blanket
Kol ta'khira fiha khira: every delay hides something good
El ba'ara lamma te'a' tekter sakakinha: when the cow falls, the knives multiply
Elli yetlese' men el shorba yenfokh fel zabadi: burned by soup, he blows on yoghurt
El 'ein basira wel eid 'asira: the eye sees but the hand is short
Ye'mel men el habba 'obba: he makes a dome out of a seed (a mountain out of a molehill)
Elli 'al bar 'awwam: the one on the shore is a great swimmer
El shoghl mesh 'eib: work is no shame
Mesh kol marra teslam el garra: the jar doesn't come out safe every time
El kelab tenbah wel 'afla tesir: the dogs bark and the caravan moves on
Gih yekahhalha 'amaha: he came to line her eyes with kohl and blinded her
El gar 'abl el dar: (choose) the neighbour before the house
Ya ma fel habs mazaleem: so many innocent people are in prison
Elli yeshoof balwet gheiro tehoon 'aleih balweto: see others' troubles and yours feel lighter
